Quotes.Quote: I’m back from hell, Dio!
I strive to be a true gentleman! There are times when a gentleman has to be courageous and fight, even when his opponent is bigger than he is and he knows he's going to lose!
I reject my humanity, JoJo!! I'll transcend humanity!
Can you remember how many loaves of bread you've eaten in your entire life?
Weakling, weakling! Did you think you ever stood a chance?! Fool!
Goodbye, JoJo!
What is "courage"? "Courage" is knowing fear and making that fear your own!
It’s finally arrived... the day he prophesied. If such is fate, I shall accept it!
You call yourself a gentleman, JoJo!? Where are your manners?! Where?!
JoJo, it is not bad... to die in the arms... of your son...
Oh, JoJo, you scoundrel!
Certain death! Thunder Split Attack!
Master Dio! Oh... ohh... if only he had another body...
Jonathan… I shall dedicate the word engraved into this sword of mine to you! Luck! And take this with you as you face what lies ahead! Pluck!
You're to mail this letter and head to the place it's addressed to! This man owes me a favor... I'm sure he will look after you and send you to school!
Is pain scary to you? Aren't you more afraid of turning into an adult and still not being able to do anything for yourself?
I'll be the one who will protect my sister! Sis! "Tomorrow" is right now!
He-llo? Could you say that again? More slowly? In a language I understand? Depending on what you said, I might kick your ass!
Your next line is...
Run away, Smokey! Move it, rubbernecks!
You may have lived a long time, but you're not nearly as smart as me when it comes to coming up with plans!
Nice one! Very nice, Caesar-ino!
CAESAAAAAR!
You may be 10,000 years old, but when it comes to the "art of deception", you need a little more time than that, Kars!
The inscrutable Ripple Bubble Launcher! Take this and go back to the countryside, Joestar!
No need! I haven't lived such a fragile life that I'd need pity from a kid who isn't even twenty yet!
He... he's become invincible! He has no more weaknesses! Not even the Ripple will work anymore! He's immortal! Unkillable! Unbeatable! Kars, the Ultimate Thing, is born!
Geez... have humans devolved since the past?
The Red Stone of Aja! I have waited four, no, five millenia for this, and now it is before me!
You fools! Don't you wish to tame the sun?! Don't you wish to dominate creation!? Don't you wish to not fear anything!?
Your next line is "I'll wipe that smile off your face!"...
I'll light you on fire like candles on a birthday cake!
Awaken, my masters!
I have no regrets... rather than aging pathetically I'd rather go to hell with the excitement of getting my youth back...
How can you beat a monster like him?! Do you have a Plan B, JoJo?!
Like Jonathan... Like Speedwagon... Oh... I can't believe it... The madness from fifty years ago... I thought it had come to an end...
Say, JoJo... you're cuter than I thought.
I can't beat the crap out of you without getting closer.
Shut up! You're pissing me off, lady!
So it's the same type of Stand as Star Platinum.
There's only one reason you lost, DIO... just one simple reason. You pissed me off.
You sure made me work my ass off for this... you can't stop time if I crush your skull first, DIO!
Jonathan's bloodline... must be eliminated.
Heheheheh... I'll give you one chance. Take two steps down the stairs, and I'll allow you to join me again. On the contrary, if you wish to die, take a step up the stairs.
The World! Time, stop!
Oh? You're approaching me? Instead of running away you're coming right to me?
Oh ho! Then come as close as you like.
Time resumes.
It's a road roller!
Invulnerability! Eternal life! Stand power!
I-I can't move! I-Impossible!
Indeed Jotaro, what you have called an "evil spirit" is but a powerful vision created by your own life energy! And since it stands next to you, it is called a Stand!
Jotaro... this is the third time I've been in a plane crash! Am I cursed?
I don't like it myself... but kids can't always rely on their parents. Now that they're all grown up... you have to take care of yourself!
Yes! Yes! Yes! Oh my God!
HmhmhmhmhahahaHAHAHA! You're a fool Jotaro! Thanks to you, I live again!
Yes, I am!
Cameo of the Judgement card, is it? I'll finish you off and give you hell!! Hell 2 U!
You'd challenge a fortune-teller to a battle of prediction? Who do you think you are?
What?! He deflected my Emerald Splash?! But that's impossible!
JoJo... are you going to eat those cherries? They don't seem like much but they're my favorite fruits. Could I have them? Thanks... rerorerorerorerorerorerorerorerorerorerorero...
It's... a message... That's... all I can do... Mr. Joestar... Please... figure... it... out...
Bravo! Oh, Bravo!!
Très bien! Très bien!
I'll just die like this. As recognition of your strength. Committing suicide at this point would be dishonorable.
I swore to avenge the cruel fate of my sister! To use my own Stand to hunt the killer down and make him pay... with his life!
With pretty legs like those, we need a full body shot!
Shut up! Don't ask me! I'm a dog! I can't talk! What are you, an idiot?

Quotes.Quotes: Oh yeah!!! Gotcha! You really are a birdbrain! Heh heh heh heh!

Quotes.Quote: Just one little wound is all I need... then Justice will do the rest!
Can you punch fog with your fists?! Can you cut fog with your sword?! Can you shoot fog with your gun?! It's all useless! Useless!! Kyakyakekekeke!!
He used to be such a good boy... and now I don't know what's happened to him!
Your sister was an absolute darling, Polnareff... once you see her again, be sure to ask how exactly I killed her!
The gun's mightier than the sword! Mmm, mmm, mmm. I love that line.
I swear I won't hit a woman! Even if she paid me, I'd never kick a woman!
Look, want some porn? It's Indian porn! I stole these from a gift shop. You like sexy pictures, right?
That's right, I'm not the real captain! I disposed of the real captain, and left him resting at the bottom of the ocean!
DO YOU UNDERSTANDDDDDD!?
My brother's book is not for sale... Just get out of here. Didn't you hear me!? I said get lost!!!
It's fate. Yes! The predictions are absolute.
Kill Joseph! Dismember Polnareff! Split Jotaro in two! You're a sword master, the strongest in the world. Destroy them all!
You're good-looking... but you're nowhere near as handsome as Lord DIO.
Your magnetic force will keep growing... until your bodies crush each other.
Even as a kid...when push comes to shove, Jotaro gets the job done...

Name: Daniel J. D'Arby
Variants: D'arby the Elder, Darby the Elder

Quotes.Quote: Go AHEAD! Mr. Joestar!
All right... we had a deal. Give it to me! Your soul...

Name: Telence T. D'Arby
Variants: D'arby the Younger, Darby the Younger

Quotes.Quote: Are you going to do the "ORA ORA" thing?!
Yo! Angelo.
You bastard... What the fuck did you say about my hair?!?!
I refuse.
May you receive judgment, Yoshikage Kira!
He may look like my dad... but he's not. There's no way he is. Just... who is he?
I-I did it! It activated!

Quotes.Quotes: Killer Queen has already touched the doorknob.

Quotes.Quote: Phewwww~ Back when I was a kid... you know Leonardo da Vinci's Mona Lisa, right? I saw it in an artbook. When I saw Mona Lisa's hands, folded by her knee... How do I say this? It's a bit crude, but... hehe... I got... a BONER.
See this? The city's energy! It's all mine! My power! Oh and the electricity bill? I'll send it straight to your place, hehe...
I just wanted to look cool in front of you.
Josuke...I...I might die here. So, if I do, please tell your mother I said hello.
I hate bein' made fun of! "Fatass, stupid pig", all these names... I'll make y'all regret mocking me!

Quote.Quote: Alien? Yes, that is the term. I'm an Alien!

Quotes.Quote: That's how good I am. You know I can't live without these gals. You perserved my beauty, so of course I'll help.
My only wish is for my father to die like a normal human being. When I was a child, I swore that I would end his misery, and because of that, I have to protect this Bow and Arrow.
The guiltier you feel, the bigger The Lock gets... in other words, that lock is the "weight of your guilt".
Koichi, you have something shining within! I know because I've always been watching... And I... I like everything about you, Koichi.
I'm not going to let you leave this house until you fall in love with me. I'll definitely make you love me, or else... I might have to kill you.
I guess I have to spend another night with that insensitive ass... The only words he ever says between getting home from work and leaving the next morning are "food", "bath", and "sleep".
I'm the kind of copy doll that people don't want to have. Once I become a copy of you, you have to pose the same way that I do... In short, I'm a doll that manipulates!
Menu? A list of food? I'm afraid... we don't have that here
That is simply fantastic! My greatest joy is... to have my customers enjoy my food, and to feel better afterwards.
You know, I didn't open this salon for the money. It's because I wanted to make people happy like the fairy godmother in Cinderella.
Enigma observes closely.
Ciao.
This taste... is the taste of a liar! Giorno Giovanna!
Giorno, was it? You don't have to stay standing. Why don't you sit down and drink some tea...

It's bad luck to take something from four things! It's fine if you're choosing from five! It's also fine if you're choosing from three! But if you choose something from four things, something bad'll happen.
Aahhh!! Giorno! Not so rough! No, not there! Nonono!! Oh! Be gentle! Gentle! Don't strip me! I can feel you! Ohh! No! No more!
I'm sorry, but none of us will board that boat. You aren't facing the facts. Nobody can survive in this world on ideals alone. We can't live without the gang.
Let's find out the Boss's identity. It's time to trace my father's past.
Leave this place, Bruno Bucciarati... if you come out from behind that pillar... you will die.
I am the Emperor. What I see is to remain upon the climax.
H... how many more times will I die!? Where will it come from next...? Wh...when will it strike next!? I... I...!
Turururururu! TURURURURURURU!!!
No matter how heavily someone breathes after massive amounts of iron have been stolen from their body... no oxygen will be absorbed into it!
You wish to defeat Diavolo, don't you!? I am your ally!
Di molto!
Congratulations, Bucciarati! You are now a capo!
To be safe... and invincible inside the mirror... That is my ability.
Stop! Damn it! This virus capsule... I-It's gonna hit me!
Cryogenic temperature is a world of stillness...
Well... It's, uh... um... It starts with an M... Mas... um... mastur... uh... bation...
I'm innocent. What do you think about that? Do you believe me?
Should I get down on all fours? Or should I lie on my back? How about a mix of both?
Revenge is for settling a score with your own fate!
OSHAAAAAAA!
Tomorrow at noon, someone's going to come to see you. But you can't. You can't go see him... You can't, no matter what!

Name: Weather Report
Variants: Weather Forecast, Domenico Pucci, Wes Bluemarine

Quotes.Quote: I'm going to be the one to kill Pucci. And after I kill him, kill me. Understand?
In order to protect Jolyne... I gotta kill that priest!
The difference between man and animal... it's the desire to "go to Heaven".
2...3...5...7...11...13...17...19.... prime numbers are solitary numbers that can only be divided by 1 and themselves... they give me strength.
Shit! There are frogs on my $800 pants.
There might be a way to go to Heaven.
Do you believe in gravity? That there might be a reason why you tripped over me, of all people?
Target changed to Jolyne! Full body confirmed! Locked on the head! Shoot!
Zero-gravity... you're probably a Stand user yourself, so let's see if you can figure out what that feels like.
Serves you right, you fucking bitch! This is what you get for trampling on my heaaaart!
How about a bet? $100 for 100 catches.
This ability has far surpassed a simple nail… it’s a Tusk. From now on I will call this Tusk.
Gyro! What are you trying to make her do?! She's only 14!
It’s truly, truly been… a very long roundabout path…
The perfect rotation energy… and I still have one nail bullet left.
Gyro, for this reason… this was the reason for “lesson 5”. Thank you… Thank you, Gyro. I truly… truly… thank you… I can’t find any other words to express it.
Tusk ACT4. The sacrifice, President Valentine! Which do you think it will really be? Ora ora ora ora ora ora oraaaah!!!!!!
Gyro… I’m sorry… I’m really sorry… I wanted to believe… I really wanted to believe the President… Goodbye. Gyro… goodbye.
Do you know the leading causes of death? The first is a sickness carried by mosquitos. The second is getting kicked by a horse and dying. Do you plan on changing the ranking?
This spinning steel is definitely my weapon.
Tell him to go eat shit, Johnny.
Eat shit, asshole! Fall off your horse!
Pizza mozarella, pizza mozarella, rella rella rella rella rella rella rella rella...
He's going to be killed... My husband was just being used... When they don't need him anymore... they're going to dispose of him.
If you're going to plan a race, it should be across the entire American continent! And the winnings should be huge! Like, $50,000,000! Real dreams should be that big!
I will become the one that can take the napkin first.
Dojyaaa~~n!
Power! Glory! Happiness! Culture! Law! Money! Food! The hearts of the people! I have taken the first napkin!
I have 'feelings' of 'patriotism'. Every action I have performed was because I judged it to be 'absolutely' for this country's sake.
My heart and actions are utterly pure…! Everything I do is for justice!
Useless, useless! I thought I told you this, Johnny Joestar! That I’d tear you apart if you came within 2 meters of me… no other organism on Earth can match up to a dinosaur’s speed!
The winds of victory are blowing at the back of me, Dio...
Johnny, I can’t bear this any longer. Even when I became a member of the church… even when I became a child of God, it didn’t work… Because I sacrificed him… My heart can’t take it anymore…
I never expected to die on a bed. I’m a cowboy. All I wanted was a place to come home to. Just a place to return after my journey…
The Zeppelis... The strength of their Steel Balls is the use of the golden rectangle. We must surpass that power!
You were chosen... some power chose you as the victor.

Listen, Lucy. […] I won’t lay a finger on you, not now, not ever… don’t worry. You should go to school. And one day, you’ll fall in love. And when you want to leave our house, you can do so anytime. But please, spare me the trouble of your future boyfriend being a mafia member.
Welcome...to the world of man...

My ability’s name is Catch the Rainbow. The raindrops I touch, I can stabilize in the air. Just like crossing a rainbow, or walking on a glass board. You can’t assume that the rain is always pouring down.

Name: Parallel World Diego
Variants: Alternate World Diego Brando, Diego From Another Univese, The World Diego, Dio

Quotes.Quote: THE WORLD! Time is mine and mine alone!
I'm the 1 in 5,000,000,000 lucky guy! UH! OHHH!

Name: Jesus
Variants: The Holy Saint, Jesus Christ, The Saint's Corpse

Quotes.Quote: I will go East.

Quotes.Quotes: If your heart is wavering... Johnny Joestar. Do not shoot.

Quotes.Quote: True happiness is found within the family. Protecting your family relates to protecting your country. For your family to fall apart is to scorn your ancestors and futures descendants. Never forget that.

Patriotism is the most beautiful 'virtue' in this world. Even animals risk their lives for the sake of their children, but risking one's life for pride in their country and thinking of it as an extension of protecting one's family is only a 'nobility of humanity'... a kind of heart completely different from a religious fanatic.
God, you took the wrong son…
Yasuho Hirose... Is that what you said...? Your name... Then who am I? What am I doing here?
My name is... Who am I...?
The only person I know is... you. Yasuho Hirose, height: 166 cm. The person that was above the ground. I don't know anyone else in this whole world.
Yeah, I hate you. But you don't lie. Your honesty is a beautiful thing about you. Do you want me to start liking you?... Then I'm going to be using this cellphone from now on. It's mine.
The second floor is dangerous! In horror movies, the characters that run to the second floor always die!
Soft & Wet... when my soap bubble touches something and breaks, I take something from there.
There's a woman who's been waiting for this Locacaca! And I'm going to take back my lost past!
Take that! Soft & Wet: Go Beyond! That bubble doesn't exist anywhere in this world.

And my memories from when I was born... Are long gone from this world... And they'll never... Come back... But even so, there's something I'm certain of. I am your son. No matter where I go, or what era I live in, that's something certain that I can believe in. Mom...
This is equivalent exchange!! The ability to equivalently exchange an ailing part with a healthy part.

I love large-size French fries, I love large-size French fries, I love large-size French fries, but they're out of fried chicken. They're out of fried chicken, they're out of fried chicken. Those crispy ones are all I need. I love large-size French fries.
I have the same motive as Josuke. I want to get my hands on the Locacaca too!
I seriously hate him... He's such an idiot.
There were 4... I'm sure of it, his balls...
The thing I'm best at might be reading maps... I really like studying maps.

When you get down to it, memories... even before memories, there may be something we'd call dreams. If at the very, very end, all that remains are memories and dreams... then maybe a dream was born out of that soil.
The priorities here are protecting me is first... then your own life comes second. She's third. Okay?
My occupation is Norisuke's personal fruit grower... I don't do business with anyone else.

Nobody is aware of it. Nobody sees it within their Stand. It's a line. The lines, they spin... Your soap bubbles are soft, spinning lines! That is the spin! And inside it, there are things that cannot... be seen...
That branch is a demon plant, there's no human who can tame it! So, I'll go collect it!
My ability is a long-distance Stand. But I'm not saying anything more... trust me... this is private too.
You wouldn't tell somebody in your own family where you hide your porno DVDs, right...? You don't go showing other people your asshole. Stands are the same way.
That branch definitely belongs to you, Josuke. You need the right path for the equivalent exchange.
When everything's over, all that will remain...are dreams and memories. That's all.
I'm her ex-boyfriend.
These hands of yours... they're really always from above, Yasuho... whenever I reach my hand out to you, you always instinctively put your hand on top of mine without saying a thing...
Looks like we ran into each other at a good time. Seems like that's always the way with us...
Calamities make no distinction between right or wrong. Honestly, even I don't know what's going to happen to you. But the one thing that is certain is that you will die very soon.
Farewell... Yasuho... After everything ends, all will remain are dreams... and memories.
P-Please, help me... Yasuho-Chan. I... Don't want to die... You're the only one... That can save me... Please... We've been friends ever since you were a child, haven't we...?
It's okay to make mistakes, right...? You're only human, after all.
I can rest easy... now that I've seen your face...
The one with superior muscle... body weight and fighting spirit always wins. Just like with human athletes.
There's one more rule to beetle fighting. If it's killed, it loses. For 45 seconds, they are gladiators.
Speed King, ignite.

Listen closely, when daddy was just a bit older than you are now, he got sick. And the one who set me on the road to getting better was my mother... your grandma Kaato. And... if someday, you get sick, too... if that time comes, then daddy will be the one to cure you. I promise I will.
That nose... it's so cool and sexy! It's kinda like my pet Hercules beetle! No, even better!
My occupation is... managing a dry cleaners... here in Morioh. It's called Damokan Cleaning. I'm 23 years old.
You daughter... belongs to me.
That day on the yacht... I did the same kind of thing with a 1000-yen bill. And I gouged out your liver. And today, I'll be slitting your throat, too!
Now then, I came here with two objectives. Though before I ask my questions, I want to give you some advice that should be quite obvious. Do not lie to me.
My Stand is called Vitamin C. It makes you severely soft.
Hey... Josuke. Did you hear that my big brother got back from his trip? He got me a souveniiir! Eheheheheheheh! Check it out! Looks real as hell, doesn't it? It's a spiny lobster figure! Sooo cooool!
Yasuho is my woman. She even let me kiss heeer...... It was a deep and hot one... rerorerorerorero...
Also, where do you get off talking to Yasuho all casual like that?! Anybody that talks to Yasuho like that is my enemy!
Caaaaalifoooooorniaaaaa! I can take one of a person's memories...!
I love you, Josuke. I'll always have your memory here with meee.. sharing them. One by one, lots of them, lots and lots... that happiness is my goal.
If this is a call from Yasuho... then he can say goodbye... to these two chess pieces... and the concept... of his important things itself... I'll completely extinguish it from this world...
I can say this decisively... I'm sure of it. Your true identity is my older brother, Yoshikage Kira... there's no doubt about it. But that's only part of you. There's another person.
I am a rock. I am an island.
So you came all the way here... to die a second time...?
Y... You're... just going to be... betrayed by the Higashikata family... anyway...
Damn! That's creepy... what fucked up birds... they're all looking this way.
This turned into something really dangerous... so the one tailing me and trying to investigate me was... hey! What the hell is going on here? Jobin Higashikata... that's your son!
It seems we won't be able to stay in this town long, either... but there's nothing to be ashamed of. It's not your fault. Because that is what I love about you most of all.
Want something to drink? I have a lil' soy milk. And some cold cola.

The Higashikata Family has believed in charms against evil spirits for generations... when the first son is born, he is dressed as a girl until he is 12 years old to trick the demons that cause disease. That happened to my dad, and grandpa, and his grandpa too.
My ability is origami. My ability is that when my origami touches a person, that person loses the ability to tell faces and designs and things like that apart...

Getting older is fine and all... but I can't let my nails get dirty or my breasts sag. After becoming the wife of the Higashikata Family, even if I'm a mom, I have to keep turning heads or it's all over for me.

You know, back in my school days, I was Miss Cherry. Lelo. As the winner of a contest, I got to travel to China and Europe for the fruit of Japan. That's how I got to know my husband Jobin and ended up marrying into the Higashikata family. I was even a model for Higashikata Fruit Parlor ads. Moreso after I had Tsurugi than when I was younger. I had support from the whole family and it helped sales, too.

The Blue Lagoon. Man, I'd love to really go there... that's my dream... To be shipwrecked, just the two of us clinging to wreckage and drifting together. We'd dive to catch fish, break open fruit from palm trees and build a tree house on an island... hpmh, though... I guess that's not all that realistic...
This is a feeling I though I'd long forgot. That girl... I wonder how old she is now? Probably around 32-33? Maybe I could try inviting her again... to the Blue Lagoon...

Living organisms exist above rocks and soil. But once you meet your death, you exist below them. You people... when you got careless, you ended up being forever below the rocks... the Rock Humans, that is! Come get me!
Don't you get iiit?!! The closer you get ta me, the higher the pressure's gonna get!! You lost, jackass! Now go die, Josuke Higashikata!

This Stand can cordon off the area around the branch. Nobody'll even be able ta get close. My Stand is called Ozon Baby. It don't matter who it is, nobody'll be able ta get to any branch in that orchard.
I want to be clear about something... You all are the evil ones.
I must steer clear of any predictable failures. 100% of patients I accept are healed. All patients want to be 100% healed. And I make those desires come true.
Oh, my! Someone dropped a magazine with such a pretty girl on the cover in a place like this?! Gee, I'm sure I've seen this person before somewheeere... It's meeeee muhuhuhuhu!!

Thank you. You did well to come here. You said your name is Yasuho-san, right...? Come again, okay?! Such a pretty girl... She... is already using "it" subconsciously, it looks like. But if she realizes how to use it, then... investigate the family tree. If she realizes that, she will give strength to my son... surely this is also Fate.

The hospital director's form cannot be grasped... Yoshikage... you absolutely must not chase after him. But it's okay to make him do the chasing. Please... Be careful... Because I want... To see you... Again.
It was Kira's knowledge that hid me from the world, right? I promise I won't tell anyone, Josefumi Kujo-kun.

These 15 years of success of the Higashikata Fruit Parlor are thanks to me, too. He may have divorced me while I was in jail, but I'm going to be compensated with money! Because I'm taking my life back. Otherwise, it wouldn't have been worth it.

Shouldn't it be obvious I'd at least want to see my kids?!! I gave birth to every one of them! And I didn't do anything wrong. Back then... I swear on the souls of my ancestors that I did the right thing. But... you abandoned me... put me in jail... and divorced me!! I'm going to get compensated after all that.
This is a port. Ojiro Sasame... you say you're a surfer, but is that a job? Are you a man of the sea? Or a man of the land? Which is it? Be decisive!
She's just a stalker but... Stand abilities are connected in some way. That's what I'm getting at. We have some kind of fated connection.
You guys can't even figure out where the Locacaca branches are. You don't know shit. And you sure as hell can't predict my plan.
I can't take it anymore... I'm always being abandoned... Nobody ever even pays any attention to me... I've worked so, so hard... but, it's always gone the same way. I just end up abandoned.

Quotes.Quotes: Please... Save Holy. Eat it... break the curse... and we'll look up at a new sky.

Quotes.Quote: I know it... That star-shaped birthmark on your shoulder... And I know... that we're connected by a mission. And while I can't see it with my eyes... I know that you have that power of the heart, a Stand!!
They call me Fumi-kun.
Let's get away from this place!! The Radio Gaga Incident wasn't just some made up story! Go call someone! We'll look for the driver with the police! I... I wanna go home!
It's probably because you were jamming out to Dua Lipa too hard
Everyone loves our mother. So mother is able to commute to the airport safely every day. That's because we brothers protect her.
Don't lay another hand on him! He's a mangaka! He may be a rich guy, but he's a special rich guy! I respect him. And I believe today's gonna turn out to be a great one.
Paco! Can you hear me? You'd better get the heck outta here before I wrap your ear around your head! Don't you dare mess with the customers in my shop! You asshole!

Quotes.Quotes: Be sure not to push yourself too hard, but don't give up.
